question: Will Russia's federal Avialesookhrana daily report still list an active forest fire in the Sayano-Shushensky Nature Reserve on October 1, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: Russian forest fires still listed as actively suppressed after ~10 days, ~150-200 ha, remote mountainous ООПТ, mid-September — surviving another ~12 days. Avialesookhrana liquidates ~183-198 fires/week nationally against ~25-40 active on any day, so durations are short and heavy-tailed; a Pareto-style conditional survival from day 10 to day 22 implies ~30-35%. Adjusting down: the perimeter has been frozen at exactly 167 ha across the Sept 15, 16, 17, 18 and 19 bulletins — a mop-up signature, not a spreading fire; Krasnoyarsk Krai lifted its emergency regime Sept 10 and cleared all forest-fund fires by Sept 16, leaving this as the sole remaining fire with end-of-season demobilization pressure; and the Yandex/Gismeteo trajectory for Shushenskoye shows a sharp cold break from ~Sept 27 (valley nights 0 to -2 °C by Oct 1-2), which at the fire's 1,000-1,800 m elevation means hard frost and likely first snow — the standard terminator for remote Sayan fires. Adjusting up: six warm dry days (+17 °C, no rain) come first, regional reporting through Sept 17 cited 'крутые склоны, ветер и отсутствие дождей' as complicating suppression, terrain over 30 degrees bars machinery so all mop-up is by hand on ~8-10 km of edge, and no bulletin has yet described the fire as локализован — agencies are slow to declare ликвидирован in a high-profile snow-leopard zapovednik, and a late-September snowfall could still leave a declaration lagging past the 00:00 MSK Oct 1 cutoff. Net: the status quo is 'active', but it has a built-in seasonal expiry inside the horizon. No prediction market prices this event.

calls.reasoning: Verified primary source: the 20.09.2026 bulletin still lists the reserve fire at 167 ha with 16 federal jumpers assigned. Prior: a fire already active 7+ days in remote mountain terrain surviving another 11 days runs ~35% under a heavy-tailed duration model (the unconditional bulletin listing life is ~1.2 days, but this fire is already deep in the tail). Downward: area frozen at 167 ha for six straight bulletins, Krasnoyarsk's forest ЧС lifted 10/14 Sept, krai down to ~2 fires, an earlier 14-ha fire in this same reserve cleared from the ООПТ line within ~8 days in August, and an 11-day late-September window in the West Sayan gives autumn rain/snow at 1500-2000 m several climatological chances even though the 14-day valley forecast flags only a 26-28 Sept damp spell. Upward: manual-only suppression on 1500 m slopes with deadfall and helicopter-slung water, no localization declared after a week, the repeated 167 ha may be measurement inertia rather than true containment, warm dry weather through ~25 Sept, and the retention of 16 jumpers while Yamal is being reinforced signals crews do not see this as nearly out. Weather-conditioned blend: 0.6*0.25 + 0.4*0.55 ~ 0.37, shaded down slightly for end-of-season liquidation pressure.

calls.reference_class: Avialesookhrana-listed active forest fires that have already been under suppression for 7+ days in remote roadless mountain terrain, evaluated for whether they remain on the active-suppression list 11 days later (conditional survival, not the unconditional per-fire listing life of ~1.2 days)

calls.reasoning: Status quo is YES: the 20.09.2026 bulletin still lists the ГПБЗ «Саяно-Шушенский» fire at 167 ha under active suppression, ~13 days after a lightning ignition around Sept 8-11. But the perimeter has been frozen at 167 ha for four straight bulletins (17-20.09) with ~70 personnel on it, which is the signature of a contained fire in mop-up rather than a growing one. Reference class: Russian forest fires already contained with a substantial force, ~10 days to run, entering seasonal shutdown — a constant-hazard fit to its own survival so far (~8-10%/day) gives ~40% survival over 10 days, but that ignores the regime change. Layering the forecast (rain Sept 21 and 26-27, snow and sub-zero temps Sept 28-Oct 1 at valley level, arriving earlier and colder at 1,000-1,900 m) onto the last four days pushes combined survival to ~13-15%. The 2025 seasonal analog is stark: by 05.10.2025 Russia had 8 fires / 84 ha and zero Siberian fires. I add back a few points for declaration lag (formal 'ликвидирован' needs ground inspection in terrain where machinery cannot go), for deep-duff smouldering in scree after a record-drought year, and for day-8+ forecast unreliability. No human market exists on this. Land at 18%.

EVIDENCE — surrounding context:

BASE RATES FOUND (with the class each is computed over):
- Unconditional, all Russian fires in the bulletin stock, mid-Sept 2026: ~14 of ~44 fires in the active stock liquidated per 24 h (19 Sept bulletin) — a daily liquidation fraction of roughly 30% over a pool dominated by young and small fires.

calls.reconciliation: Disputes: (1) fire age — Run 4 used ignition 13-14 Sept and a day-7 hazard; I checked the 11.09.2026 bulletin and it already carries the reserve fire at 89 га, so ignition was ~8-10 Sept and the fire is ~12 days old, not 7.5. This invalidates Run 4's hazard framing and argues for LOWER daily hazard (tail selection), pushing up against its 0.14. (2) Newest bulletin — I fetched the aviales.ru feed: newest is still 00:00 MSK 20.09.2026 (id 10490); no 21.09 bulletin, so Run 1's gap is a publication lag, not a missed status change; Runs 2/3/4's reading of 20.09 stands. (3) Weather — runs split three ways on whether the late-Sept cold intrusion is wet. I retrieved meteoblue for a ~1500 m point inside the reserve (the only mountain-elevation forecast any run has obtained; all others were the Shushenskoye valley station at ~330 m): snow 28 Sept, snow with 20-50 mm water-equivalent 29 Sept, then highs +1/+2 C and lows to -4 C 30 Sept-2 Oct. Two of three independent providers now agree on decisive snow at the fire 2-3 days before the snapshot; GisMeteo's 0 mm is the outlier and its precipitation row failed to extract for multiple runs. (4) Targeted search for 'локализован'/'ликвидирован' on this fire returned nothing — an empty check, reported as such. (5) Pure JUDGMENT, unbroken by evidence: whether the absence of a 'локализован' declaration at day 12 signals slow containment (up) or is merely an artifact of the bulletin's one-line aggregate ООПТ format that never breaks out per-fire status (down). No evidence settles it; I bet on the artifact reading and do not take Run 2's upward adjustment. Net: a two-gate model — P(still listed 27 Sept) ~0.55 from a tail-adjusted ~7-9%/day mop-up hazard, times P(snow slips or the ликвидирован declaration lags past 30 Sept) ~0.55 — gives ~0.28, shaded to 0.25 for the seasonal-shutdown empirics (05.10.2025 bulletin: 8 fires/84 га nationally, zero Siberian). Market check: none found on Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or bookmakers, consistent with the harness search; no anchor available.
